verdict.rationale: incident.io's first-party webhooks documentation says users can receive notifications when events occur in incident.io. It names concrete use cases, including syncing alerts, escalations and schedule changes to external tools, which directly delivers event subscription via webhooks. missing for 10: documented event-type catalog and subscription/registration steps, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks can be used to receive notifications when certain events occur in incident.io.
This might be useful for annotating graphs in a monitoring tool with incidents, keeping track of follow-ups, or syncing on-call data
syncing on-call data like alerts, escalations, and schedule changes to external tools.
